title: Resilience, failure states and disaster recovery
flow: Detect incident and suspend unsafe money-moving routes where needed
Protect committed journal, outbox and audit data from destructive replay
Restore validated backup or failover replica with known recovery cursor
Replay eligible unprocessed messages through consumer deduplication
Reconcile journal totals, external settlements, fees and outstanding outcomes
Obtain separate operations/CFO acceptance before resuming affected flows
rules: Recovery cannot edit an original posted journal or manufacture missing payment finality
Use institution-approved RPO/RTO values only after tested measurement
Unknown external payments remain quarantined until source statements or authority clarify
Backup consistency must include journal, outbox, keys and audit references
Runbooks must account for lost acknowledgements and duplicate deliveries
DR rehearsals must produce evidence, not only a plan or architectural drawing
test_cases: Kill publisher after DB commit and verify exactly one recovered business effect
Replay consumer batch twice without duplicate posting
Restore backup and reconcile source account totals
Simulate missing external statement and prevent finality declaration
Require dual authorization to reopen rail after a severe outage
approval_gate: Operational recovery environment, signed RPO/RTO, real fault-injection execution and independent CFO/Operations review.
